resources.name: Transit API
resources.description: Public REST API for a fictional transit market: stops, routes, vehicles and bookings.

resources.name: Stops
resources.description: Collection of stops with a random getter.

resources.name: Routes
resources.description: Routes and their stop sequences.

resources.name: Vehicles
resources.description: Fleet vehicles and filters.

resources.name: Bookings
resources.description: Full booking lifecycle: create, read, update, delete.

resources.name: Error scenarios
resources.description: Requests that intentionally exercise the API error taxonomy (400/404/405/422/429).

resources.name: Health check
resources.description: Liveness probe. Expect 200.

resources.name: List Stops
resources.description: Paginated stop list. Supports sort/order, offset/cursor and filters (city, stopType, zone, name).

resources.name: List Stops (filtered)
resources.description: Filter by city and stop type using environment variables {{ _.stop_city }} and {{ _.stop_type }}.

resources.name: Get Stop by ID
resources.description: Pre-request script picks a random existing stop and stores its id as {{ _.stop_id }}.

resources.name: Stops - page 1 (stores cursor)
resources.description: First page. The after-response script stores meta.nextCursor into {{ _.cursor }} so the next-request works.

resources.name: Stops - next page (uses cursor)
resources.description: Follow-up page using the cursor saved by the first-page request.
resources.preRequestScript:
const cursor = insomnia.variables.get('cursor');
if (!cursor) throw new Error('No cursor stored yet. Send "Stops - page 1 (stores cursor)" first.');

resources.name: List Routes
resources.description: Paginated route list. Supports filters (city, mode, active, minFare, maxFare).

resources.name: List Routes (active, cheapest first)
resources.description: Only active routes sorted by fare ascending.

resources.name: Get Route by ID
resources.description: Pre-request script picks a random existing route.

resources.name: Get Stops for a Route
resources.description: Pre-request picks a random route; after-response stores its first/last stop as {{ _.from_stop_id }}/{{ _.to_stop_id }} for creating bookings.

resources.name: List Vehicles
resources.description: Paginated vehicle list. Supports filters (status, vehicleType, routeId).

resources.name: List Vehicles (active buses)
resources.description: Active buses using {{ _.vehicle_status }} and {{ _.vehicle_type }}.

resources.name: Get Vehicle by ID
resources.description: Pre-request script picks a random existing vehicle.

resources.name: List Bookings
resources.description: Paginated booking list with joined route/stop names. Supports filters (status, routeId, travelDate, minFare, maxFare, passenger).

resources.name: List Bookings (by travel_date + status)
resources.description: Bookings on {{ _.travel_date }} with status {{ _.booking_status_filter }}.

resources.name: Get Booking by ID
resources.description: Uses {{ _.booking_id }} if present, otherwise the pre-request script fetches one.

resources.name: Create Booking
resources.description: Pre-request script picks a random route and two different stops on it, then the body is rendered with those ids. After-response stores the new booking id/reference.

resources.name: Update Booking (PATCH)
resources.description: Updates seats (fare is recomputed server-side) and sets status to pending.

resources.name: Delete Booking (DELETE)
resources.description: Deletes and clears {{ _.booking_id }} on success.

resources.name: limit=0 -> 400 INVALID_QUERY
resources.description: Expect 400.

resources.name: active=maybe -> 400 INVALID_FILTER
resources.description: Expect 400.

resources.name: malformed booking id -> 400 INVALID_ID
resources.description: Expect 400.

resources.name: unknown route -> 404 NOT_FOUND
resources.description: Well-formed but nonexistent id. Expect 404.

resources.name: create booking (bad payload) -> 422
resources.description: Several validation failures at once. Expect 422 VALIDATION_ERROR.

resources.name: DELETE /stops/:id -> 405
resources.description: Expect 405 with an Allow: GET header.
